title.narrative: Safe Trade Kenya Country Programme -Advocacy Interventions (COVID-19)

description.narrative: The E-commerce Booster Programme is one of the interventions under the Safe Trade Emergency Programme (STEF) that aims to cushion jobs and livelihoods; and build the resilience of Small and Medium Enterprises in Kenya amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. It will be implemented through one of TMEA’s existing partners, The Kenya Private Sector Alliance (KEPSA). The e-commerce programme intends to implement interventions around rollout support to targeted SMEs and enhance the potential of e-commerce locally and internationally.
The provided cumulative expenditure figures excludes the related overhead and project management costs for the period from 2023/01/31 to 2023/03/31
